description: Costs 2 credits. Returns a semantic snapshot: the accessibility tree, the interactive elements, and a selector for each. Use this before domscout_automate_page to find out what is on the page and what to target. Requires Pro or above.

delay.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after load.

detail.description: "full" is slower and always returns asynchronously.

url.description: The page to load. Must be http(s) and publicly reachable. Credentials in the URL (https://user:pass@host) are rejected; these tools capture as an anonymous visitor, so use the REST API directly if the page needs authentication.

waitForSelector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before capturing.

name: domscout_inspect_page
title: Get the interactive structure of a page
